text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Training is o-ver! I'm so hungry!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, the statues of the Three Goddesses! I 
have to say hello!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hello! I worked super hard in training 
today, too~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best all day tomorrow too!! I 
sure hope the Three Goddesses are watching 
over me!
